data.description: A spine dragon's body is covered with long, crystalling spines. It can fire up to four of these spines/round as a full-attack action (or one as a standard action). A creature that attacks a spine dragon with a melee weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon must make a DC %1 Reflex save or take 2d8+%2 points of piercing damage from the spines.
data.name: Spines
